ITEM.PTXT: The A/T filler tube and level gauge have been discontinued, and a new oil level detection mechanism (overflow method) has been adopted.
Because the oil level is guaranteed by the A/T manufacturer, mixing of different fluids and overfilling or underfilling in the field can be prevented, making it maintenance-free.

When adjusting the oil level during repair or replacement, the oil level can be adjusted mechanically by the overflow method while checking the fluid temperature with the illumination state of the shift indicator on the instrument panel, improving the accuracy of oil level control. For detailed oil filling and adjustment procedures, refer to the Repair Manual.
